verdict.rationale: Nix/NixOS is a package manager and declarative OS, so background automation is a fair question for it. However, no first-party evidence documents a Nix feature for setting up autonomous automations. The only nearby items are community mentions that NixOS handles systemd service configuration well and that a user enabled auto-gc. These are host-platform (systemd) or adjacent features, not the story's capability, so they earn no credit.
